newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH boosted by brisk champagne sales.
newsitem.headline: LVMH boosted by brisk champagne sales.

text.p: Shares in French luxury goods group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton were boosted on Monday by reports that champagne sales set a new record this year in volume terms, helped by strong exports, brokers said.
"The high champagne sales have helped LVMH in particular," a dealer said.

The newspaper Les Echos, citing champagne producers, said more than 250 million bottles would be sold in 1996, breaking the previous record of 249 million bottles sold in 1989. But it said this year's sales represented around 15 billion francs, down from 17 billion in 1989, because of pressure on prices.
It ranked LVMH as the top seller, with around 50.7 million bottles sold in 1995. Its shares were up 33 francs, or 2.32 percent, at 1,455 francs at 1555 GMT.
Shares in Remy-Cointreau, ranked fourth, were up 0.40 francs at 145.30.
